title: Settings → Email: DMARC progression reflects the _dmarc policy
journey: Seed a sending-domain row whose _dmarc TXT record is p=none
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email and expand DNS records
In the DMARC policy panel, confirm the stepper highlights 'Monitor' (p=none) and the guidance says to move to p=quarantine next
Update the seeded _dmarc record to p=quarantine and reload
Confirm the stepper now highlights 'Quarantine' and the guidance points to p=reject next
